bio.text: Becca Balint represents Vermont in the U.S. House of Representatives and is the first woman and first openly LGBTQ person to do so.
She taught middle school in Windham County for fourteen years and served in the Vermont State Senate, becoming President Pro Tempore in 2021.

She received a B.A. from Smith College, a master's in education from Harvard University in 1995 and an M.A. in history from the University of Massachusetts Amherst in 2001, and lives in Brattleboro, Vermont.
